stories.title: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild.

stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: VMware 0-Day, Java4Shell, NGINX2Root, Ruby2Shell, and a Whole Lot of Shell Trouble
stories.summary: A stolen key. A trusted message. A routine update. None of these looks like the start of a major security problem. That's partly why they work. stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild. stories.title: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
stories.summary: McDonald's Japan, the fast-food giant's Japanese subsidiary, has disclosed a data breach after attackers accessed a database containing sensitive information for users of the company's official smartphone app.

stories.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
stories.summary: Broadcom has shipped patches to address 23 vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, including one critical bug that could be abused to bypass authentication. stories.title: Spanish LaLiga confirms hackers stole soccer fans’ personal data
stories.summary: LaLiga, Spain's top men's football league, disclosed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to users of its services and those of some affiliated clubs.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. stories.title: European Commission Uncovers Data Breach in Cyberattack Investigation
stories.summary: Names and email addresses of EU Academy users were exposed in the AI-assisted cyberattack the European Commission detected in October.
